title: tehas freeze and tehas thaw --json
description: The object tehas freeze <issue> --json and tehas thaw <issue> --json print, version 1: one issue and what the freeze files of its cycle say. host/docs/api.md says what each field means. Every object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too; a program that reads the object still accepts fields it does not know. The keys print in this order. test/json_contract_test.sh checks the sample beside this file against it.
